title: OBT Launch Celebration — First Level 55 & Chip War Bounty Pool
summary: Compete across Bellato, Cora, and Accretia during Open Beta launch week for Archon titles, Cash Points, and molten launch cosmetics.
details: The first 3 warriors per race to reach Level 55 receive 50,000 Cash Points, the permanent "Ember Vanguard" cape, and a +4 Intense Weapon Box. Every Chip War Breaker during launch week also unlocks a Guild War Supply Crate.
